description: Finds bookable holistic and wellbeing sessions on Sissoo (sissoo.com), from reiki, massage and yoga to coaching, counselling and psychotherapy, online or in person, in several languages. Matches a short description of what the person is looking for, with optional place, format, session language, timing, budget and stage (new to it, or going deeper). Returns up to 8 sessions with price (booking fee included), next free time and a link to the service page with that date picked. Read-only: booking and payment happen on sissoo.com. Not for emergencies or crisis support: crisis wording returns helplines instead of sessions.

currency.description: Currency for prices: GBP (default), EUR, USD or AUD.

lang.description: Language of titles and booking pages: en, de, fr, es, it or pt. Default: the user's locale, else en.

max_price.description: Highest price per session in the chosen currency, booking fee included.

need.description: What the person is looking for, in a few of their own words: a type of session ("reiki", "life coaching") or what they hope for ("sleep better", "less stress"). No names or health records.

place.description: City or country, for in-person sessions.

session_language.description: Language the session is held in, as a two-letter code, e.g. "de".

stage.description: Where the person is with this kind of session (Sissoo's 3 E's). emerge: new to it or trying it for the first time; first steps (free intro calls, first sessions) come first and repeats, follow-ups and programmes are left out. evolve: has tried it and wants to go deeper; programmes, series and follow-ups come first. Leave it out when they haven't said.

within_days.description: Only sessions with a free time within this many days.

name: search_services

as_of.description: When the free times were last refreshed.

crisis.description: Set when the words suggest self-harm or an emergency: helplines instead of sessions.

crisis_note.description: Helplines, set whenever talking therapies are listed.

id.description: Service id for get_service and next_free_times.

misses.description: Filters this session does not meet (shown only when too few sessions met them all).

start.description: Start, ISO 8601 with the UK offset.

place.description: City and country for in-person sessions; null when online only.

text.description: Price with the booking fee included, or "free".

session_languages.description: Two-letter codes of the languages the session is held in.

stages.description: Sissoo's 3 E's, where a client is with this kind of session: emerge alone = a first step for someone new to it; evolve alone = for going deeper (series, programmes, follow-ups); both = open to anyone; empower = community or guiding others. Empty until Sissoo has sorted it.

url.description: Service page on sissoo.com, with the next free day picked.

suggested_types.description: Service types on Sissoo, when nothing matched.

title: Search Sissoo sessions
